_doc: [camp] The landing yard (systems/camp/camp.gd, systems/camp/yard_builds.gd). A fresh base starts with only the pod, a broken workbench and the trash bin. Lumi repairs the bench (bench_repair_s) the first time E is pressed at it. Yard builds are bought in the Hub tab: requires_level is the hub level, requires_flag a GameState flag (first_sprout = the first seed has grown). pos is [x, z] in the yard (CityLayout.YARD_HALF = 8.5; the fence runs along the back and both sides, the front at +z is open). Keep every yard interactable at least min_gap metres from the next. Every yard structure is a Hub-tab build (systems/camp/hub_builds.gd): once-builds drop off the list when built; tiered ones (trash bin, signal tower) show only their next tier. requires_bench: only after the workbench is repaired.

shack.name: Lean-to
shack.desc: Salvaged pipe and corrugated iron over the workbench, with a work lamp. Shelter for the crew.

generator.name: Generator
generator.desc: A patched portable generator by the lean-to. It hums; the yard feels lived in.

lamps.name: Yard Lamps
lamps.desc: The street lamp and the pole lamps along the fence, rewired. Light for the yard at night.

composter.name: Compost Press
composter.desc: Presses plant scraps into compost and seeds. Worth building once something grows.

radio.name: CD Player
radio.desc: A chunky old CD player on a crate by the fence. Plays the discs you find.

locker.name: Locker
locker.desc: A tall steel locker by the bench. Open it to change Lumi's look, Glim's and your robots'.

nursery.name: Robot Nursery
nursery.desc: A walled lawn with flower beds where retired robots tend the garden and lend your crew a hand.
